title: Pax 3 Portable Vaporizer – Complete Kit (taxes extra)
description:
PAX MINI AND PAX PLUS NOW AVAILABLE

A super portable vaporizer for dry herbs and extracts.

The PAX 3 is powerful yet discreet, smart yet easy-to-use. Pax’s engineering and technology gets the best out of your flower.

Features:
– Conduction oven heats your cannabis flower gently and evenly so there’s little waste
– 22-second heat-up time for on-demand vaping
– Temperature settings so you can achieve your ideal combination of flavor and vapor

Includes:
– PAX 3 Device
– Flat & Raised Mouthpieces
– Standard Oven Lid
– USB Charger
– Maintenance Kit

Complete Kit also includes
– Half Pack Oven Lid
– Concentrate Insert
– Multi-Tool (Keychain)
– 3 Screens
